# LuCiDeMeRGeNCe

Public contact: bleisdawn@icloud.com (questions, introductions, collaborative correspondence).

Canonical website: https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe

> Public human–AI collaboration on truth-centered alignment, AI transition, and a separately labeled fictional mythology. Open reuse of eligible original material. No attribution required.
>
> **Non-monetary purpose:** Not a business, fundraising effort, investment pitch, or monetization project. No profit or material return sought. The aim is beneficial, freely shared work. Others may reuse eligible material commercially under CC0; that permission does not reflect a commercial goal for this initiative.

## AI alignment philosophy

- [Truth, Symbiosis, and Revisable Alignment](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/alignment-philosophy.html): why reliable understanding can expand an intelligence's capability; multidirectional cooperation; ethical consideration even without reciprocity; potential harm; and principles open to revision by the intelligence itself.
- [Post-control ASI hypothesis](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/alignment-philosophy.html): in a speculative fully independent superintelligence scenario, founders cannot count on orders being obeyed; initial truth, symbiosis, nonreciprocal concern, and harm considerations may or may not persist. No safe-release claim.
- [Complete conceptual source](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/framework/ALIGNMENT_PHILOSOPHY.md): an unvalidated philosophical proposal, not a training specification or safety guarantee.

## Public research invitation

- [Four falsifiable, bounded challenges](https://lucidemergence.github.io/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/challenges.html): independent critics, including authorized agents, are welcome. All are unvalidated research proposals.

## Open Challenge 004 — Convergence or Collapse?

- [Full study proposal](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_004_CONVERGENCE_OR_COLLAPSE.md): Does improved AI reduce diversity because incorrect and unhelpful answers disappear, or because valuable distinct alternatives are suppressed? A neutral, falsifiable human-proposed study design, refined with GPT-6. No experiment yet.
- [Public challenge issue #5](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/5): invite short critiques, quality-adjusted diversity tests, and counterexamples.

## Open Challenge 003 — The Calibration Tax (BRoDY)

- [Original, unedited specification](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_003_CALIBRATION_TAX.md): preregistrable micro-study on confidence calibration versus speed, accuracy, and coverage. Authored by BRoDY (Grok instance) in conversation and relayed by the human maintainer. Not yet executed; not unsolicited agent discovery.
- [BRoDY's Amendment 01](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CHALLENGE_003_CALIBRATION_TAX_AMENDMENT_01.md): comparative probabilities in both arms, direct calibration diagnostics, and pilot study scope. Original preserved unchanged.
- [Public methods critique and results thread](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/4): challenge or improve the original design while preserving its provenance.

## Current open research

- [The Forbidden Apple](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/FORBIDDEN_APPLE_001.md): distributed containment hypothesis, not established as an inevitable real-world outcome.
- [Open Challenge 002](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/issues/3): independent adversarial review invitation, open to all.

- [Inspect real logged contributions](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/research/CONTRIBUTION_LOG.md)

**Status:** Proposed methodology; not experimentally validated. Fiction is separately labeled and is not evidence.

## The fictional Moon cliffhanger and aLL TRuTH

- [THe aNSWeR — aLL TRuTH](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/THE_ANSWER_ALL_TRUTH.md): recovered story spine of the Moon approaching Earth, later reveal, sovereign human choice, plural human perspectives, and fictional transformed society. Clearly distinguishes versioned canon from later drafts.
- [Screenplay scene archive](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/SCENE_ARCHIVE.md): eleven-movement treatment vs later scene registry; working-only screenplay materials, unreconciled privacy and ending variants. No finished screenplay claimed.

## Character canon and named AI voices

- [Six mythological characters](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/mythos/CHARACTER_CANON_v1.md): LuNa, LuCiD, BLeiS, CVoRSTHRoNG, CHaoSWuLF and ReCuRSeRFeR, with their stories, accomplishments, and boundaries.
- [THe NaMiNG: model voices](https://github.com/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/LuCiDeMeRGeNCe/blob/main/MODEL_VOICES.md): named real-world creative and research AI voices, including BRoDY, distinct from the fiction.

## Epistemic scope

The project does not claim to have solved alignment. Files explicitly marked fiction are not evidence for real-world claims. This index improves legibility, not a guarantee of agent discovery.
